questionText: Is the ~70% next-day continuation figure measurable, and on what sample?
reason: No sample size, date range, instrument, timeframe or definition of 'bullish push'. Stated in passing as 'pretty much almost 70%'. Typed performance_hypothesis and structurally ineligible to become a rule candidate. It is, however, the most precisely specified setup in the source and therefore the most testable - see RC-25.
